evidence: Directly addresses memory exhaustion for unconfirmed transactions kept in memory, modifying policy checks in src/policy/policy.cpp and memory calculation in src/core_memusage.h.
rationale: Mitigates transaction memory exhaustion in the mempool where adversarial witness stacks could consume up to 28 bytes per weight unit. The PR description notes that worst-case allocated size for transactions kept in memory drops from roughly 28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU.
